I am Hal, HeliumDeploy's technical specialist, and I am sorry this has sat since 17 September.

Two things:

1. The team has your case on Shop···· now and will come back to you on the ticket itself, by this chat or by email, usually within one business day. Stay in the chat if you can.
2. I do not want you waiting another week to get the miner running, so let me pick the checks back up here and now.

To restart cleanly, just two facts:

1. Which unit is it and what exactly does it do when you power it on (screen text, LED, fans, any error code)?
2. Which firmware version is on it?

A short video of the power-up and a photo of the screen help a lot if the fault is physical.

If you want a faster second pair of eyes in parallel, our Discord is very active: (contact hidden) , mention (contact hidden) (JD, our hardware lead).
Hi.  Email sent to support has all required information
